analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata against the indexed model and selected T-041 details. ErrorMapping.swift:65,161–162,262 maps unsupportedOutputControl to bounded client-error/invalid-request/400 values without exposing associated strings; no supported regression there. GLM5NextLoading.swift:69–94 introduces loader-derived verified hashes and persistent identity-bound records while retaining manifest equality, catalog/capability and geometry checks. Integration must verify GLM5NextManagedLoad actually hashes all relevant artifacts and binds verification to the loaded bytes, and that WeightHasher/VerifiedWeightHashStore and callers cannot associate an old verified hash with a newly sampled fingerprint after mutation (A-004, T-012, T-027; T-041 cache weight binding). Those implementations and callers are not supplied; comments do not establish their contracts.
InferenceHandler.swift adds GLM5NextWiredLimitNotice.report at head lines 577,1023,1325, passing raw errors and decrypted caller-selected model IDs. Review that reporter's filtering, serialization and output bounds for prompt/model-string disclosure or diagnostic flooding (A-001, TB-003); its implementation is absent, so leakage is not established. Head lines 1147–1149 and 1218–1219 extend deadline satisfaction and first-output timing from withheld reasoning to withheld output. Verify the signal producer marks actual generated output, retains cancellation/absolute runtime bounds, and agrees with coordinator timeout and usage semantics (T-010, TB-007). The supplied admission/decryption/receipt-finalization source shows no changes to authenticated cache scope, encryption or reservation cleanup. No concrete regression is independently supported in this scope; the missing verification, diagnostic and output-signal contracts remain material integration questions.
